[SWS_EM_02548] Create error information
⌈
Execution Management
shall provide a means to create error information.
The function ara::exec::ExecErrorDomain::ThrowAsException takes an er-
ror code as parameter. It creates a new instance of ara::exec::ExecException
from the error code and throws it as a C++ exception. This error code can be created
via the function ara::exec::MakeErrorCode.
⌋
